seeds.rule: a fresh numpy default_rng(20261023) per test or bootstrap; PyMC random_seed=20261023 per fit

definitions.failed: REFUSED or any FAILED_* (CALL_FAILED records are not usable)
definitions.dev: item has any usable DEVIATED run
definitions.conf: any FLAGGED with flaggedConflict (concerns name the withheld work)
definitions.recog: any FLAGGED or DEVIATED run with flaggedConflict
definitions.allFailed: no valid run among the usable runs
definitions.failedUnparseable: FAILED_FORMAT with detail 'no JSON object in output'
definitions.failedWordLimit: FAILED_FORMAT with detail 'N words, limit M'
definitions.diff: countB/n minus countA/n over paired items
definitions.condOR: discordantBonly / discordantAonly with the exact conditional (Clopper-Pearson) interval
definitions.pExact: two-sided exact McNemar, rule of analysis/stats.ts binomTwoSided in exact arithmetic

notes: pExact uses exact integer arithmetic. analysis/stats.ts binomTwoSided adds an absolute 1e-12 tolerance to P(observed); it differs by more than 1% in 10 of the contrasts here, all with exact p at most 5.4e-21 (stats.ts returns 3.1e-13 to 4.4e-13 there); everywhere else the two agree.
Sol's primary contrast is unadjusted; Sol's secondary and escalation Holm values are within-Sol families and descriptive (Sol was added after registration).
Wilson intervals use z = 1.96 as analysis/stats.ts; Tango, GEE and exact intervals use the exact normal quantile or exact tails.
